description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'MyBaseListFragment' that extends Android's ListFragment. It manages profile-based shortcut lists, handles lifecycle events, registers receivers for user profile changes, and reacts to system events related to package and shortcut updates. The class is intended as a base class for fragments displaying lists of app shortcuts, with mechanisms to refresh and update the displayed data based on system changes.

classes.name: MyBaseListFragment
classes.description: An abstract fragment class for managing a list of app shortcuts, handling system profile changes, package updates, and shortcut modifications. Designed to be subclassed with custom list refresh logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UserManager and LauncherApps services, registers callback.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Logs resume event, shows permission warnings, refreshes list, registers profile receiver.

methods.name: showPermissionWarningToastWhenNeeded
methods.description: Displays a toast warning if the app lacks shortcut permissions.

methods.name: getAppLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the display label for a given package, caching it for performance.

methods.name: refreshList
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to refresh displayed data.
